source: you-search tool, from tools/list on https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free

exclude_domains.note: Same meaning as the shared exclude_domains (up to 500); not mapped yet.

freshness.note: day | week | month | year, or a YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD range.

knowledge.note: core; knowledge results stay in raw.

extraction_source.note: cache | fetch | blend; full_page extraction only.

include_domains.note: Not an argument of you-search: set per host under params._meta or an X-Search-* header. The tool maps an inline site: operator in the query to it (its tools/list description: 'Inline site:, lang:, loc: filters are mapped automatically'), a candidate for the shared option.

boost_domains.note: Host-only: set under params._meta or an X-Search-* header, which provider_options cannot reach.

country.note: Not an argument of you-search: set per host under params._meta or an X-Search-* header. The tool maps an inline loc: operator in the query to it (its tools/list description: 'Inline site:, lang:, loc: filters are mapped automatically'), a candidate for the shared option.

language.note: Not an argument of you-search: set per host under params._meta or an X-Search-* header. The tool maps an inline lang: operator in the query to it (its tools/list description: 'Inline site:, lang:, loc: filters are mapped automatically'), a candidate for the shared option.
